knownBlockers.detail: Spirit Poop obtain/display is wired; -1 score helper is not consumed by a production total-score calculation.

lizardTail.limitation: Controlled rare-tier draw uses unmodified full source seed65536 queue, then actual obtain/fatal/rollback and chapter/map ownership. Fairy/Bark/Flower queue vectors and controlled prior chapter completions are not natural acquisition or gameplay. Native per-item/device and noncombat owned-relic detail remain pending.

blackStar.limitation: Modern full-source BossChest acquisition and subsequent elite two independent rarity draws/noncamp reward are covered with controlled navigation and terminal enemy HP. Legacy Inventory.bossEligible remains unchanged. No natural campaign, PC binary order or native acceptance claim.

mindBloom.limitation: Act3 source mapping, public Nodes/Run event-combat bridge, fixed Boss/reward preparation, Awake permanent upgrades and Mark obtain are locally wired. Integration bridge fixture recorded a 12.35s GREEN before this inventory sync; final combined-HEAD and native acceptance are not granted. Full natural campaign and complete ordinary/shrine/once catalog remain pending.

mysteriousSphere.limitation: Act3 mapping and existing-controls UI are locally wired. Constructor prepares two Orb Walkers even on Leave; Fight uses inclusive 45..55 miscRng gold and shared rare-relic/event rewards. Integration bridge fixture recorded a 12.35s GREEN before this inventory sync; final combined-HEAD, full natural campaign and platform/live acceptance remain pending.

mark.limitation: Named SPECIAL obtain, MindBloom Awake, Run/Nodes camp/Cleric/combat-end healing and the shared player healing gate are locally wired. Component tests and the integration bridge fixture (12.35s GREEN) are recorded; final combined-HEAD, whole natural campaign and platform/live acceptance remain pending. Existing no-Mark values and enemy healing are retained.

cards.limitation: 75 base/upgraded ordinary executions and focused interactions covered locally; full source/queue/RNG/acquisition parity and natural per-item platform evidence remain required.

generatedCards.limitation: Four status cards and ten curses are defined. Explicit event transactions include complete curse transformations and Wheel Decay; full default event admission and natural/platform evidence remain pending. None count toward 75 class cards.

enemies.limitation: Encounter construction coverage does not establish every AI branch, source parity or natural victory.

encounters.limitation: 17 source queue bindings plus Guardian-unseen Boss. Formal Nodes entry and finite formation member ranges are inspected separately from legacy explicit IDs. Per-item natural acquisition, platform and live verification remain pending.

events.limitation: Seven default random events and 27 additional explicit event routes are inventoried, including both final Act3 ordinary mappings. Full source catalog admission and all natural/platform evidence remain pending. Six additional Act2 mappings (Beggar, Mausoleum, Addict, Back to Basics, Ghosts, Joust) have explicit default-launch inventory routes and unchanged experimental full-pool mappings; their existing-controls NodeUI event routes and mandatory Beggar picker are locally wired with mocked generated-control/public Nodes+Run tests. Actual native acceptance NOT_RUN; this does not establish natural/history/full-pool acceptance. Beggar empty mandatory purge group remains pending without cancel, refund or zero-choice completion. Back to Basics uses free non-bottled purge or exact source starter upgrades; both outcomes retain result then Leave. Original V4 starter-tag mapping is unresolved, so only Simplicity is explicitly unavailable; Elegance supports V4. Ghosts A0 caches entry maxHP loss, decreases current maxHP before five real permanent Apparition obtains, then retains result until Leave. Toxic Egg upgrades, when available, belong to the existing Run acquisition hooks; Ghosts does not manually upgrade rewards; no manual reward upgrades or full acquisition-hook completeness claim. The Library is tracked separately in the library profile; no native/natural acceptance is granted.

relics.limitation: All 142 canonical relic definitions are integrated offline, including the complete 130-identity Ironclad source mother queues used by treasure, shop and event preparation with source eligibility. SPECIAL relics retain explicit channels. Spirit Poop total-score deduction has only a helper and no production score consumer. Controlled offline coverage does not establish natural acquisition, native per-item, complete-run execution or device acceptance; platform/live evidence remain pending.

potions.limitation: Complete source-ordered Ironclad 33-potion selection is wired to rewards, shop and Entropic. Other classes and original characters require explicit source-pool policies; full generated-card dependencies, combinations and per-item platform/live acceptance remain pending.

bosses.limitation: One Boss on floor 16, separate treasure on 17. M2 completion does not prove every Guardian transition.

legacyEncounters.limitation: Historical explicit-ID development/replay inputs, not the formal source queue or natural acquisition channels.

sharedCards.limitation: 35 ordinary shared cards plus four SPECIAL mechanics dependencies. SPECIAL event acquisition and per-item natural/platform acceptance remain pending. These are not part of any 75-card class count.

falling.limitation: One Act 3 event only. Default Act 1 restricted-seven unchanged; source-full development campaign and exact transactions tested locally. Remaining Act 3 events and platform evidence are not covered.

moai.limitation: One Act3 event component. Golden Idol acquire/combat reward/same-owner sacrifice is now covered by goldenIdol profile; historical held-owner fixtures remain. No complete campaign or platform/live acceptance.

winding.limitation: Winding Halls component; unsupported permanent damage/revival relic hooks reject atomically. No full M3, complete natural run or platform acceptance.

goldenIdol.limitation: Actual single relic/event component and source-pool boundary selection; full default Act1 admission, whole campaign and platform/live remain pending. Existing currency glyph is an explicitly documented temporary art fallback.

library.limitation: Four mapped full Run class catalogues only; historical prepared/original-V4 Read disabled without source mapping. Exact20 unique source offers, duplicate rarity+identity retry, unchanged pity, detached previews/fresh actual obtain and cached binary32 Sleep are locally tested. Toxic, Molten and Frozen Egg share real type-specific preview and permanent acquire hooks with local coverage. Global cosmetic reading text is fixed rather than spending gameplay RNG. Native and natural four-class four-act acceptance NOT_RUN.

classCommonRelics.limitation: Snake Skull, DataDisk and Damaru are available in their original Silent/Defect/Watcher common queues; complete catalogs, queue order and RNG remain unchanged. Offline hooks and public shop/chest/elite obtain controls are covered, including captured Poison constructor ownership, Focus/orb identity, Mantra/stance thresholds and external acquire rollback. Room and terminal fixtures are not a complete natural campaign. Dedicated art and platform/live acceptance remain pending.

mushrooms.limitation: Actual single relic/event component and source-pool boundary selection; full default Act1 admission, whole campaign and platform/live remain pending. Existing currency glyph is an explicitly documented temporary art fallback.

maxHpRelics.limitation: Pear, Mango and Lee's Waffle use the complete existing shared + chosen-class queues with unchanged order/RNG. Source equipment heals respect held-order healing modifiers and active battle health; outside obtains do not rewrite retained battle history. Controlled modifier/terminal fixtures are not natural modifier acquisition or a complete campaign. Ordinary PC A0 only; original-V4 active contexts and max-health overflow refuse atomically. Native/platform/live evidence remains pending.

copyAndMatchEvents.limitation: Independent production leaves and real Nodes/generated native controls tested locally with controlled event admission. Full natural campaign, official import, PC and physical Android acceptance remain pending. Supplied-board candidate stays separate.

relicCompletion.limitation: The additional 77 canonical relic definitions and their acquisition/combat/selection callbacks have controlled offline regression coverage. This records local coverage only; native per-item, natural acquisition, complete-run execution and device acceptance remain pending.
